desc:
Looking for a true 5v5 tactical FPS or Valoblox-style shooter where you can hold every vantage point with real agent abilities, ranked queues, and full console support? Welcome to Fearless Contract.

🎮 FULL CONSOLE & CROSSPLAY: Built for PC, Mobile, Xbox, and PlayStation (PS4 & PS5) with 6 controller presets, Focus Mode, custom aim curves, dynamic glyphs, and console KBM support.

⚡ AGENTS & ABILITIES: Pick your main and master smokes, flashes, recon, and movement kits to lock down angles and control every vantage.

🏆 RANKED: Duo up, trade kills, and climb the Ranked leaderboard from Iron to Radiant.

🔥 UPGRADED SKINS: Unlock weapon skins and bundles with full Lv4 animations, SFX, VFX, and finishers—no extra upgrade grind.

🎯 MODES: Ranked 5v5, Swiftplay, TDM, Gun Game, and Bedwars.

Join our server below for updates & hacker reports.

Not associated with VALORANT or Riot Games.
